title: Everyday life
summary: All the simple tenses (the past, the future in `-jAk` with no personal ending, the general present in `-Ar`) and *eken*, ability with *bilmek*, necessity, suggestions and wishes, comparison, postpositions, compound nouns, the progressive with *otyr* and *ýör*, and the first word-building suffixes.
canDo: Say what happened, what usually happens and what will happen
Say what you can and must do, make suggestions and offer good wishes
Describe where and when things happen, and follow a simple story or folk tale
